_doc: Per-record binding of a bare variety word the disciplinare writes short, keyed by the MASAF record slug (a sottozona annex reads its parent's entry) -> normalised surface (lower-case, accents folded) -> {slug, reason, source, verified}. The lexicon's bare alias is the convention everywhere else (VIVC lists bare TREBBIANO under Trebbiano toscano); a pin needs the document's own article 2 to name the variety in full. A pin whose slug is not in the lexicon, or whose record has no sidecar, fails tests/test_masaf_roles.py.

trebbiano.reason: Article 2 writes the Romagna Trebbiano wine's variety in full, "Trebbiano Romagnolo: minimo 85%", and "Trebbiano" for the same variety in the Bianco types and in the Oriolo annex ("Trebbiano: minimo 70%"); the bare alias gave Trebbiano toscano, so the parent and the Oriolo card carried Ugni blanc.
trebbiano.source: MASAF disciplinare Romagna DOC, Art. 2 and Allegato 9 (sottozona Oriolo) Art. 2

trebbiano.reason: Article 2: "Colli di Faenza Trebbiano. Vitigno Trebbiano Romagnolo 100%" — the bare word is the wine type's name, its variety the Romagnolo.
trebbiano.source: MASAF disciplinare Colli di Faenza DOC, Art. 2
MASAF disciplinare Colli d'Imola DOC, Art. 2

malvasia.reason: Article 2: "«Cagliari» Malvasia e «Cagliari» Malvasia riserva — Malvasia di Sardegna: minimo 85%" — the bare word is the wine type's name, its variety Malvasia di Sardegna (the card had shown both).
